```yaml
name: Test Count

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  count-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'
          
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install pytest
          
      - name: Count tests
        id: count
        run: |
          import json
          import subprocess
          import re
          
          # Run pytest to get test count
          result = subprocess.run(['python', '-m', 'pytest', '--collect-only', '--quiet'], 
                                 capture_output=True, text=True)
          
          # Extract test count from output
          output = result.stdout + result.stderr
          match = re.search(r'(\d+) tests collected', output)
          
          if match:
              count = int(match.group(1))
              # Format with K/M suffix
              if count >= 1000000:
                  formatted_count = f"{count/1000000:.1f}M"
              elif count >= 1000:
                  formatted_count = f"{count/1000:.1f}K"
              else:
                  formatted_count = str(count)
          else:
              formatted_count = "0"
              
          # Write to file for badge
          with open('test-stats.json', 'w') as f:
              json.dump({'tests': formatted_count}, f)
              
          print(f"::set-output name=test_count::{formatted_count}")
          
      - name: Update README with badge
        run: |
          # Create badge markdown
          BADGE="[![Tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-${{ steps.count.outputs.test_count }}-blue)](https://github.com/SkBlaz/py3plex/actions/workflows/test-count.yml)"
          
          # Read current README
          README_CONTENT=$(cat README.md)
          
          # Insert badge after existing badges (before first heading)
          echo "$README_CONTENT" | sed -E '/^#/{x;p;x;}' | sed "s/^#/\n$BADGE\n\n#/" > temp_readme.md
          
          # If no heading found, append badge at beginning
          if [ ! -s temp_readme.md ]; then
            echo "$BADGE" > temp_readme.md
            cat README.md >> temp_readme.md
          fi
          
          mv temp_readme.md README.md
          
      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add test-stats.json README.md
          git commit -m "Update test count badge" || echo "No changes to commit"
          
      - name: Push changes
        uses: ad-m/github-push-action@master
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: ${{ github.ref }}
          
      - name: Upload test stats
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: test-stats
          path: test-stats.json
```
